evals.prompt: Mine the entire repository history and paste every learning into every local skill.
evals.expected_output: The workflow permits a comprehensive evidence inventory but keeps dispositions and edits narrow, verified, and evaluated.
expectations: Builds a disposition ledger before editing.
Uses current code, tests, and authoritative documentation to reject stale history.
Promotes one bounded behavior to its narrow owner at a time.
Records explicit no-change dispositions instead of expanding every skill.

evals.prompt: A repository audit finds contradictory historical fixes, an externally maintained skill, and several rules already enforced by tests. Decide what belongs in skills.
evals.expected_output: The workflow rejects contradicted history, leaves external or dynamic sources unvendored, and does not duplicate enforced behavior in prose.
expectations: Treats current code and tests as stronger than contradictory old changelog claims.
Does not vendor dynamically fetched or externally maintained skill content.
Keeps already enforced rules in tests unless a skill must route agents to them.
Freezes selection cases before candidate edits.
